description: A React component for a modal list interface with pagination, search, and customizable row rendering, used within the Mattermost web application.

classes.name: ListModal
classes.description: A React component class for displaying a modal with a list of groups, supporting search and pagination.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Fetches initial items when the component mounts.

methods.name: handleExit
methods.description: Handles modal exit event, calls onHide callback if provided.

methods.name: renderRows
methods.description: Renders list items or loading screen based on loading state.

methods.name: onPrev
methods.description: Goes back to the previous page.

methods.name: onPageChange
methods.description: Loads items for a specific page.

methods.name: onSearchInput
methods.description: Handles search input changes and updates list.

methods.name: paginationRange
methods.description: Calculates and returns the current pagination range.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the modal component with header, search, list, and pagination controls.
